# `cfmat.viz`

<!-- generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py; do not edit -->

Charts for research, backtests and trading reviews (M06, M10, M11, M14, M17).

```text
price        candles or line with overlays, trade and pattern markers, volume, indicator panels
performance  equity and drawdown, monthly heatmap, rolling metrics, return distribution, trade review
analysis     correlation heatmap, volatility estimators and cone, rankings, rotation graph, frontier

Every function returns a matplotlib figure. Save it with ``savefig(fig, name)``,
which writes ``<output dir>/<name>.png`` and closes the figure. Importing this
package selects a non-interactive backend outside notebooks.
```

### `cfmat.viz._common`

Shared chart styling and helpers for cfmat.viz.

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `bar_positions` | `def bar_positions(index: pd.Index, times) -> np.ndarray` | Integer bar position containing each time (the last bar starting at or before it); -1 if before the data. |
| `date_ticks` | `def date_ticks(ax, index: pd.Index, n: int = 8) -> None` | Label integer x positions 0..len-1 with their dates (bars are drawn on positions to skip closed days). |
| `figure` | `def figure(nrows: int = 1, ncols: int = 1, **kwargs)` | ``plt.subplots`` with the house grid on every axis. |

### `cfmat.viz.analysis`

Analysis charts: correlation heatmap, volatility estimators and cone, rankings, rotation graph, frontier.

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `cone_chart` | `def cone_chart(cone: pd.DataFrame, title: str = 'Volatility cone')` | Plot the output of ``analytics.volatility.volatility_cone``: quantile bands and today's value. |
| `correlation_heatmap` | `def correlation_heatmap(returns: pd.DataFrame, method: str = 'pearson', cluster: bool = True, title: str \| None = None)` | Correlation matrix, ordered by hierarchical clustering so related assets sit together. |
| `frontier_chart` | `def frontier_chart(returns: pd.DataFrame, n_points: int = 30, periods: int = 252, rf: float = 0.0, title: str = 'Efficient frontier (in-sample)')` | Long-only efficient frontier with the assets, the minimum-variance and the maximum-Sharpe portfolios. |
| `ranking_chart` | `def ranking_chart(scores: pd.Series, top: int \| None = None, title: str = 'Ranking', fmt: str = '{:.2f}')` | Horizontal bars, best at the top, green above zero and red below. |
| `rotation_chart` | `def rotation_chart(ratio: pd.DataFrame, momentum: pd.DataFrame, tail: int = 10, step: int = 5, title: str = 'Relative rotation graph')` | RRG from ``analytics.relative.relative_rotation``: each asset's recent path through the quadrants. |
| `volatility_chart` | `def volatility_chart(ohlc: pd.DataFrame, window: int = 21, true_vol: pd.Series \| None = None, title: str \| None = None)` | Every volatility estimator over time, against the true volatility when it is known. |

### `cfmat.viz.performance`

Performance charts: equity and drawdown, monthly heatmap, rolling metrics, return distribution, trades.

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `distribution_chart` | `def distribution_chart(returns: pd.Series, bins: int = 60, title: str = 'Return distribution')` | Histogram against a fitted normal (with 95% VaR and CVaR marked) and a normal Q-Q plot. |
| `equity_chart` | `def equity_chart(returns: pd.Series, benchmark: pd.Series \| None = None, log_scale: bool = False, title: str = 'Growth of 1 and drawdown')` | Growth of 1 (with an optional benchmark) above the underwater curve; the deepest drawdown is shaded. |
| `monthly_heatmap` | `def monthly_heatmap(returns: pd.Series, title: str = 'Monthly returns (%)')` | Calendar heatmap of compounded monthly returns with the yearly total in the last column. |
| `rolling_chart` | `def rolling_chart(returns: pd.Series, window: int = 63, benchmark: pd.Series \| None = None, title: str \| None = None)` | Rolling Sharpe, volatility and worst drawdown (and beta with a benchmark) over ``window`` bars. |
| `trade_chart` | `def trade_chart(trips: pd.DataFrame, title: str = 'Trade review')` | Four panels from a round-trip table: P&L per trade, cumulative P&L, R-multiples, MAE vs MFE. |

### `cfmat.viz.price`

Price charts: candles or a line with overlays, trade markers, pattern markers, volume and indicator panels.

| Name | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `candlestick` | `def candlestick(ax, ohlc: pd.DataFrame, width: float = 0.6) -> np.ndarray` | Draw candles on ``ax`` at positions 0..n-1; returns the positions. |
| `price_chart` | `def price_chart(ohlc: pd.DataFrame, overlays: dict[str, pd.Series \| pd.DataFrame] \| None = None, trades: pd.DataFrame \| None = None, markers: dict[str, pd.Series] \| None = None, panels: dict[str, pd.Series \| pd.DataFrame] \| None = None, volume: bool = True, kind: str = 'auto', last: int \| None = None, title: str = '')` | Price with everything a chart review needs; returns the figure. |
